component.name: Mardexas
component.summary: Modern WYSIWYG Markdown Editor for Desktop

description.p: Mardexas is a desktop Markdown editor with a true rich-text WYSIWYG interface. Write and format your text visually without typing formatting characters like hashes or asterisks by hand, and save clean, standard UTF-8 CommonMark/GFM files.

ul.li: Visual formatting: headings, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, blockquotes, and lists
Interactive table editor with column alignment and keyboard navigation
Comprehensive Find and Replace with text and table cell highlighting
Document statistics: word count, character count, and reading time estimates
Fast native performance with bundled Java runtime
Available in 10 languages including English, German, French, Spanish, Japanese, and Chinese

description.p: Release 1.0.0 featuring true WYSIWYG editing, GFM table support, search and replace, document statistics, line numbers, and localization in 10 languages.
